input.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photo, shot like a premium smartphone consumer ad: natural, unglamorous, true to life. A woman in her late 30s, a real-looking mom with natural proportions, not a model, not influencer-polished, minimal makeup, hair loosely tied back. She stands in the entryway of a comfortable, ordinary Midwestern suburban home, just inside the front door, with the kitchen visible softly behind her. She holds her car keys up at chest height in one hand, mid-gesture, plain metal keys on a simple ring with a small plain fob. She glances off camera to screen-right with a matter-of-fact, slightly distracted, questioning expression, mouth just opening to speak. Not angry, not smiling for the camera. Simple neutral everyday clothing: an oatmeal knit sweater over a plain white tee, no logos, no printed text. The home is lived-in but uncluttered: a wooden bench with a couple of pairs of shoes, a coat hook with a rain jacket, a small console table, warm beige walls. Late-afternoon natural daylight from a window on the left side of frame, warm color temperature around 4500K, soft realistic shadows. Camera at chest height, roughly 26mm smartphone-equivalent lens, moderate depth of field with the background readable and only gently soft, not a shallow-focus glamour look. Realistic skin texture, no retouching, no text anywhere.
